description: This file implements custom versions of snprintf and vsnprintf functions ('git_snprintf' and 'git_vsnprintf') with specific handling for buffer sizes and platform differences. It includes conditional corrections for Windows compilers and manages buffer reallocations to ensure safe string formatting.

methods.name: int git_vsnprintf(char * str,size_t maxsize,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: A wrapper around vsnprintf that handles buffer sizing and platform-specific quirks, ensuring safe formatting of strings with variable argument lists.

methods.name: int git_snprintf(char * str,size_t maxsize,const char * format,...)
methods.description: A wrapper that initializes variadic arguments and calls git_vsnprintf, providing a safer snprintf alternative.

ctags.name: git_vsnprintf
ctags.pattern: /^int git_vsnprintf(char *str, size_t maxsize, const char *format, va_list ap)$/
